Description
Product Description
Add trusted quality and global value to your portfolio with the 1 oz Nadir .999 Silver Bar, securely sealed in tamper-evident assay packaging. Produced by Nadir Metal Rafineri, a LBMA-accredited refinery based in Turkey, this silver bar offers exceptional purity and consistent craftsmanship for both investors and collectors.
Each bar is struck from 99.9% pure silver and comes individually sealed in an assay card that certifies its weight and authenticity. With a sleek, modern design and a compact format, the 1 oz Nadir silver bar is a versatile addition to any precious metals collection, perfect for stacking, gifting or diversifying your holdings.
Product Features
Silver Content
: Contains 1 troy ounce of .999 fine silver
Assay-Backed
: Sealed in tamper-evident packaging with matching assay card confirming weight and purity
LBMA-Accredited Refinery
: Minted by Nadir Metal Rafineri, recognized for high standards in metal refining
Refined Design
: Features Nadir’s official logo, weight, purity, and origin stamped on the bar
Ideal for Investors
: A practical, cost-effective way to own investment-grade silver
Compact and Stackable
: Perfect for both new buyers and seasoned bullion collectors
